responsibility: Implements the move-path-based initialization analyses for MIR places: maybe initialized, maybe uninitialized, definitely initialized, and ever initialized. This file owns how drop-flag and move-data information are translated into dataflow state across statements, terminators, call returns, and enum-discriminant switches, so other passes can determine whether places may, must, or have ever held initialized values and reason about dynamic drop obligations and unreachable unwind behavior.
